name: 🧠 AI-01 | AI Threat Enrichment Layer (Claude API)

parameters.query: UPDATE bt_alert_log SET ai_narrative=$1, kill_chain_stage=$2, ai_urgency=$3, ai_verdict_hint=$4, ai_enriched_at=NOW() WHERE event_id=$5

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ event_id: $json._event_id, kill_chain_stage: $json.kill_chain_stage, urgency: $json.urgency, narrative: $json.threat_narrative, verdict_hint: $json.analyst_verdict_hint }) }}

meta.description: Calls Claude claude-opus-4-5 on every alert to generate: kill chain stage, MITRE techniques, blast radius, immediate actions, analyst verdict hint.
